mapper.select: SELECT id, name, source, external_id AS externalId FROM sys_group ORDER BY name
SELECT g.id, g.name, g.source, g.external_id AS externalId FROM sys_group g JOIN sys_group_member m ON m.group_id = g.id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT g.id FROM sys_group g JOIN sys_group_member m ON m.group_id = g.id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND g.source = #{source}
